# AMP Insurance Assistance

> AMP Insurance Assistance is the bilingual (English and Spanish) insurance service of Ana María Palacios. She helps people quote auto, home and property, renters, travel, and business insurance through Best Travel Assistance, an insurance brokerage, with one-on-one help by WhatsApp. She does not offer life or health insurance.

## Who does what
- Travel insurance: Ana María Palacios is the licensed travel insurance agent.
- Auto, home, renters, and business insurance: Ana is the client's advisor. A licensed agent at Best Travel Assistance prepares the quote and issues the policy.

## Insurance pages
- Auto insurance: https://samirawad24.github.io/amptravelinsurance/auto-insurance.html
- Home and property insurance (homeowners, condo, landlord, flood, umbrella): https://samirawad24.github.io/amptravelinsurance/home-insurance.html
- Renters insurance: https://samirawad24.github.io/amptravelinsurance/renters-insurance.html
- Travel insurance: https://samirawad24.github.io/amptravelinsurance/travel-insurance.html
- Business insurance (general liability, commercial property, commercial auto, workers' comp, professional liability): https://samirawad24.github.io/amptravelinsurance/business-insurance.html

## How to get a quote
1. Choose the type of insurance in the quote form and answer a few questions.
2. WhatsApp opens with the details ready to send to Ana.
3. You get options and prices on WhatsApp, and Ana helps with the purchase.

Quotes are free with no obligation. Languages: English and Spanish.
